title: v1.0 — Salon finances, clients, expenses, invoices & universal search
summary: First tagged release. Adds client profiles with comment reminders, business expenses with net profit, invoices with PDF attachments, optional browser notifications, and universal on-device search across every record.
changes: Client profile page with comment timeline and optional reminders
Business expenses with category filters, Excel/PDF export, and net profit in Analytics + Dashboard
Invoices with line items, paid/unpaid status, and PDF/photo attachments stored in IndexedDB
PDF invoices are parsed on upload to pre-fill vendor, date, total, and currency
Universal search bar with instant keyword match and opt-in multilingual semantic search (on-device model)
Optional browser notifications for due client reminders
Device storage diagnostics, runtime-cache controls, and versioned backups during schema migrations
Service worker preserves CDN caches (PDF.js, Tesseract, transformers) across build updates
CI pipeline with i18n parity check and regression tests
